ULOG-AUTH-001.title: auth_token_expired
ULOG-AUTH-001.description: Access token expired for a user or service; refresh attempted or required.
ULOG-AUTH-001.remediation: Attempt token refresh; if refresh fails notify user/ops and fail request cleanly.

ULOG-NET-001.title: upstream_timeout
ULOG-NET-001.description: Request to an upstream service timed out before a response was received.
ULOG-NET-001.remediation: Retry with exponential backoff; increment circuit-breaker counter and alert if threshold exceeded.

ULOG-DATA-001.title: schema_mismatch
ULOG-DATA-001.description: Incoming payload does not match expected schema (missing/extra fields or wrong types).
ULOG-DATA-001.remediation: Reject payload, write invalid sample to quarantine with schema diff, notify data owner.

ULOG-MODEL-001.title: model_drift_detected
ULOG-MODEL-001.description: Model performance or statistical metrics drifted beyond configured thresholds compared to baseline.
ULOG-MODEL-001.remediation: Pause affected predictions, mark outputs as suspect, run drift-analysis pipeline and schedule retraining or rollback.

ULOG-STORE-001.title: redis_connection_refused
ULOG-STORE-001.description: Unable to connect to Redis (or equivalent cache): connection refused or network unreachable.
ULOG-STORE-001.remediation: Fallback to persistent store, mark cache unavailable, alert infra and retry with exponential backoff.

ULOG-DB-001.title: db_transaction_deadlock
ULOG-DB-001.description: Database transaction rolled back due to a deadlock or transaction conflict.
ULOG-DB-001.remediation: Retry transaction with randomized backoff; if repeated, escalate to DB admin with transaction trace.

ULOG-SVC-001.title: missing_environment_variable
ULOG-SVC-001.description: A required configuration or environment variable is missing or invalid at startup.
ULOG-SVC-001.remediation: Fail fast on startup; log required var name, alert deploy pipeline and the owner to remediate.

ULOG-TP-001.title: external_502_bad_gateway
ULOG-TP-001.description: Third-party vendor returned 502/Bad Gateway or similar upstream 5xx response.
ULOG-TP-001.remediation: Retry with jitter and circuit-breaker; log vendor incident id and notify vendor owner if persistent.

ULOG-SYS-001.title: cpu_sustained_high
ULOG-SYS-001.description: CPU usage sustained above configured threshold for an extended period.
ULOG-SYS-001.remediation: Consider autoscaling or reducing load, inspect running processes, collect diagnostics snapshot and alert ops.

ULOG-SEC-001.title: pii_exposed_in_log
ULOG-SEC-001.description: Personal or sensitive information detected in logs and requires immediate redaction/response.
ULOG-SEC-001.remediation: Immediately redact logs, rotate any exposed credentials, notify the security team and open an incident ticket.
